evidence: Modifies src/headerssync.cpp, src/headerssync.h, and src/net_processing.cpp to dynamically calculate DoS-protection parameters when headers sync starts.
rationale: Calculates headers presync parameters dynamically at runtime to ensure optimal DoS resistance and memory bounds indefinitely. Hardcoded parameters degraded over time and could inflate peer memory bounds by a factor of 50 if the system clock was corrected after boot, while also resolving an attack model flaw where an attacker halts mid-batch.
